what: v4.16: section 1 of a marker holds the SPREAD of its Lay Limits table as a u16 at file offset 520 (section 1 + 216): 0 single ply, 1 face to face, 2 book fold, 3 tubular. And the piece-row flag at +14 is the M (major piece) option of the piece's Lay Limits row.
how: Order Editor (own process) on a copy of the order CLAUDE-D4 (model CLAUDE-CURVE: three sizes, its one piece is a CUT X02 pair): only the Lay Limits table and the marker name changed, then Process. Read straight from storage (accumark_marker.read_storage_marker).

ZZSP-CT.note: single ply: the pair is two slots (plain + mirrored 0x80), presets alternate per size

ZZSP-F2.note: face to face: the pair is ONE slot; slot word 0x0040 = the M option

ZZSP-BK.note: book fold: one slot per size, no 0x0040

ZZSP-TB.note: tubular: one slot per size; presets 0 / 0x2000 / 0 (same size same direction)

tables: laylimits/ZZLL-F2F-R5.GT_lay, ZZLL-BOOKFOLD.GT_lay, ZZLL-X2.GT_lay; the real L in laylimits/REAL_SUPPORT_TABLES.json
corpus: 56 of 56 markers that bundle their Lay Limits table: table spread == the word (54 single ply, 2 face to face); 341 of 341 piece rows on 78 markers: flag @+14 == the M option of the row.
